outcome_evidence: The oven door is closed at frame 0 in left_ego_image. The robot progressively approaches the oven’s handle area (frames 40, 150, and 240 in image and wrist_image), but no door-opening motion is visible. At frames 270–275, image and left_ego_image still show the door closed while wrist_image shows the gripper near the handle. Completion is unconfirmed at the recording’s end; the images do not establish a completed failed grasp or pull, rather than an unfinished approach/acquisition attempt.
